title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & bump actions
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: Our repo has accumulated >30 GitHub Actions workflows that duplicate lint/test/release steps across packages. This PR consolidates the common pipelines into a single reusable CI workflow (ci.yml) with matrixed jobs for lint, unit/integration tests, and release automation while improving cache hit rates and bumping several action versions for security/hygiene. Summary of changes: Consolidated separate lint/test/release workflows into .github/workflows/ci.yml; introduced a lightweight composite action for setting up monorepo node/tooling; standardized cache keys across node/maven/python jobs; bumped actions (actions/checkout v4, actions/cache v4, actions/setup-node v4) and replaced deprecated uses; cleaned up legacy per-repo scripts and updated docs. Testing & rollout: Jobs run with conservative concurrency; release job gated behind a manual approval for the first 48 hours post-merge. Smoke-tested against redwood, redwood-sdk-python, and redwood-helm-charts. Recorded cache hit improvements (from ~38% to ~72%) on warm runs. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows - [x] Bump actions and deps - [x] Add e2e gating + manual approval for release job - [x] Update CONTRIBUTING.md and internal CI runbook - [x] Validate on sample repos
